about: Golden vectors for the daily-pay pass engine (advisor/otd.py) and the browser planner. Each case: a market, the rating already held and today's date, and the rungs, best and weak tiers expected, plus whether the market's month shares were unusable so the sport's months stood in (month_share_estimated). Numbers to 4 decimals; compare with an absolute tolerance of 0.001. Cases marked hand_checked were worked by hand against the pass-economics table (note says how). Rules they follow: General pays nothing On This Day (limit 0), so it is a rung only for a season with live games left, where it pays those games alone and costs the mint alone (rating 0, route "mint"); a past season starts at Common; weak compares only rungs with a limit; a rung pays back within 5 years or never, and only when its lifetime beats its cost (breaking even is not paying back).

cases.name: player_ladder_at_5_per_point
cases.note: Pass-economics table at 5 a point: lifetime per rax 4.00 / 4.29 / 3.33 / 4.55 / 5.95 / 5.28 (Common to Mystic; General pays nothing On This Day, so a past season has none); Rare weak. Mystic is under Legendary but is the last rung with a limit (Iconic has none, so it is never compared), so it is not weak.

cases.name: player_ladder_at_10_per_point
cases.note: Pass-economics table at 10 a point: 3.33 / 3.00 / 2.00 / 2.50 / 3.12 / 2.68 (Common to Mystic); Rare weak (2.00 under 3.00 and 2.50). Common pays 50 a month on a flat calendar, so its cost of 300 is back after exactly 6 months, at the end of April 2027.

cases.name: player_ladder_at_20_per_point
cases.note: Pass-economics table at 20 a point: 2.50 / 1.88 / 1.11 / 1.32 / 1.60 / 1.35 (Common to Mystic); Rare weak. Common (600 a year for 400) pays the most a rax, 1.5: it is best (General, which tied it, pays nothing On This Day).

cases.name: legendary_limit_12500_year_capped
cases.note: Season 600 at 1x: Epic would pay 6,000 a year but stops at 5,000; Legendary 15,000 but stops at 12,500 (rating planner case). Legendary costs 200 + 380 x 10 = 4,000; at 15,000 / 9 a month from November it is back in 2.4 months, in January 2027.

cases.name: iconic_no_limit_three_year_horizon
cases.note: Iconic has no limit: lifetime counted over 3 years = 3 x 500 x 150 = 225,000 for 200 + 3,380 x 5 = 17,100.

cases.name: team_ladder_nba
cases.note: Team ladder, S = 1,935 (pass-economics table): limits 1,500 ... 128,000; Iconic takes 128,000 / 11,610 = 11.0 years. General pays nothing On This Day, so a past season has none. Team cards have no rate, so no rung has a cost and none is best.

cases.name: fighter_limits_from_reals_table
cases.note: Fighter: Real's own limit table, stated (Common 1,500 ... Mystic 48,000; Iconic none). Its table also prints 800 for General, but General pays nothing On This Day, so a past season has none.

cases.name: soccer_player_limits_estimated
cases.note: Soccer: player law, every limit estimated, Iconic has none.

cases.name: current_season_half_played_projection
cases.note: NFL, half played, 150 so far, so S = 300. Common: 300 live + min(300, 1,000) = 600 a year, projected; lifetime 1,000 (live pay counts toward the limit, so the live 300 leaves 700 of it). 100 a month from November: 300 is back after exactly 3 months, end of January. General pays only the 150 live left, under its 200 mint: it never pays back.

cases.name: current_season_nearly_done_not_projected
cases.note: 92 % played: not a projection.

cases.name: current_season_capped_live_outside_limit
cases.note: Half played, 600 so far (S = 1,200): the live half (600) is paid whole but uses 600 of Common's 1,000 limit, so only 400 is left On This Day: 600 + 400 = 1,000 a year, capped, lifetime 1,000. General pays only the live 600.

cases.name: dear_rating_nothing_pays_back
cases.note: 90 rax a point: every card-built limit is below its cost, and General pays nothing On This Day: no rung pays back.

cases.name: held_212_epic_reached
cases.note: 212 held = Epic; 32 of it is unused until Legendary at 380: add 168 for 1,680 (no mint, cards only). Legendary pays 12,500 in the next 12 months (capped); 15,000 / 9 = 1,666.7 a month, so back early December. Only Legendary and Mystic have a limit, so no rung has two neighbours: none is weak.

cases.name: held_10_common_reached
cases.note: Common reached: rungs from Uncommon, cards only; no General.

cases.name: nba_bought_in_july
cases.note: S = 360, Common costs 300 and pays 720 / 9 = 80 a month Oct-Jun: nothing in Jul-Sep, then 80, 160, 240 by December, the last 60 in January: 6.75 months.

cases.name: nba_bought_in_november
cases.note: Same pass bought 1 November: 80, 160, 240 by January, the last 60 in February: 3.75 months.

cases.name: nba_bought_mid_november
cases.note: Bought 12 November: 19/30 of November pays 50.67, then 80 a month; 290.67 by February, the last 9.33 in March: 0.633 + 3 + 0.117 = 3.75 months, as from 1 November, but paid back a month later.

cases.name: not_mintable_cards_only
cases.note: Not mintable: no General, and the cost is the cards alone.

cases.name: mint_cost_unstated_uses_rule
cases.note: No mint cost stated: the rule's 200 for a player pass, in Common's 300 (200 + 10 x 10).

cases.name: nfl_bought_in_march_waits_for_september
cases.note: NFL pays Sep-Feb: bought in March, nothing until September.

cases.name: small_season_pays_back_over_years
cases.note: S = 50: Legendary pays 1,250 a year (104.17 a month) for 4,000: 38.4 months, in January 2030.

cases.name: no_earnings_never_pays_back
cases.note: A season with no earnings pays nothing back.

cases.name: iconic_beyond_horizon_never
cases.note: S = 50: Iconic's 3 years (22,500) are less than its 34,000.

cases.name: held_at_iconic_has_no_rungs
cases.note: Nothing above Iconic.

cases.name: month_share_missing_falls_back_to_sport_months
cases.note: Month shares all zero: the sport's months, evenly (WNBA May-Oct), flagged as estimated.

cases.name: past_general_is_no_rung
cases.note: A past season: General pays nothing On This Day and has no game left to pay live, so it is no rung; the ladder starts at Common, the 200 mint and 10 rating at 10 a point. The season paid 300 at 1x: Common pays 600 a year, 50 a month from 1 November, so its 300 is back after exactly 6 months, at the end of April 2027.

cases.name: current_general_pays_its_live_games_only
cases.note: Half played, 450 so far (S = 900): General costs the 200 mint alone, has a limit of 0 and pays only the 450 of live games left, 37.5 a month on a flat calendar: 200 is back after 5 + 12.5 / 37.5 = 5.33 months, in April 2027. Lifetime 450 / 200 = 2.25. Common's lifetime is its limit: the live pay counts toward it.

cases.name: payback_just_inside_five_years
cases.note: S = 31: Common's 300 at 62 a year is back after 58.06 months (September 2031), inside the 5 years; Legendary's 4,000 at 775 a year would take 61.9, so it never pays back.

cases.name: payback_past_five_years_never
cases.note: S = 29: Common's 300 at 58 a year would take 62.07 months, past the 5 years: no rung pays back.

cases.name: month_share_empty_falls_back_to_sport_months
cases.note: No month shares at all: the sport's months, evenly (NBA Oct-Jun), flagged as estimated.

cases.name: month_share_wrong_length_falls_back_to_sport_months
cases.note: 11 month shares instead of 12: unusable, so the sport's months, evenly (NBA Oct-Jun), flagged as estimated.

cases.name: last_day_of_the_year_wraps_to_january
cases.note: Bought on 31 December: only that day is left of December, then January onward; the payback month rolls into the next year.

cases.name: leap_day_counts_29_days
cases.note: 29 February 2028 is the last day of a 29-day month.

cases.name: negative_month_shares_count_as_zero
cases.note: A negative share is read as 0 and the rest are scaled to add up to 1.

cases.name: all_months_zero_falls_back_to_sport_months
cases.note: Twelve zero shares are unusable: the sport's months stand in.

cases.name: held_rating_negative_counts_by_its_size
cases.note: A negative card counts by its size: -212 reaches the same rung as 212.

cases.name: rate_traded_zero_costs_only_the_mint
cases.note: A traded rate of 0 prices every card at nothing: the mint alone is the cost.

cases.name: unlimited_horizon_base_zero_pays_nothing
cases.note: A season with no earnings pays nothing: no rung pays back.
